violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the dishwashing area was lacking paper towels. PIC replaced. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the dishwashing area. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. PIC replaced. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026
The hand-washing sink in the bathroom was lacking hand-washing signage. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the walk-in cooler and retail shelves have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026

The facility is lacking a mop sink. At least one mop sink or one curbed cleaning facility equipped with a floor drain must be provided and conveniently located for the cleaning of mops or similar wet floor cleaning tools and for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid waste. New Violation. Correct By: 06/20/2026
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026
The receptacle in the toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

The floors in the walk-in cooler and retail areas (under shelving units) have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026

The floor and wall junctures at the back wall (near walk-in cooler entrance) do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2026
The ceiling in the 3 bay sink area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 06/20/2026
Dust pan and coffee mugs were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. New Violation. Correct By: 10/02/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the (retail food storage shelves) have an accumulation of dust. New Violation. Correct By: 10/09/2024

The floors in walk in cooler have an accumulation of soil residue and/or other debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/02/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (front storage and walk in cooler) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 10/16/2024
